mapper.select: SELECT c.cart_id, c.user_id, c.created_at, c.updated_at, u.username FROM carts c JOIN users u ON c.user_id = u.user_id WHERE c.user_id = #{userId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO cart_items (cart_id, room_id, check_in_date, check_out_date, guest_count, price) VALUES (#{cartId}, #{roomId}, #{checkInDate}, #{checkOutDate}, #{guestCount}, #{price}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE guest_count = VALUES(guest_count), price = VALUES(price), updated_at = NOW(), deleted_at = NULL -- 이미 담겨있던 아이템이 soft delete된 상태였다면, 다시 추가될 때 deleted_at을 NULL로 초기화
mapper.select: SELECT ci.cart_item_id, ci.cart_id, ci.room_id, ci.check_in_date, ci.check_out_date, ci.guest_count, ci.price, ci.created_at, ci.updated_at, r.name as room_name, a.title as accommodation_title, a.accommodation_id, (SELECT image_url FROM images WHERE reference_id = r.room_id AND reference_type = 'ROOM' AND is_main = true LIMIT 1) as image_url FROM cart_items ci JOIN rooms r ON ci.room_id = r.room_id JOIN accommodations a ON r.accommodation_id = a.accommodation_id WHERE ci.cart_id = #{cartId} AND ci.deleted_at IS NULL -- soft delete된 아이템 제외 조건 추가 ORDER BY ci.created_at DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE cart_items SET deleted_at = NOW() WHERE cart_item_id = #{cartItemId} AND deleted_at IS NULL
UPDATE cart_items SET deleted_at = NOW() WHERE cart_id = #{cartId} AND deleted_at IS NULL

UPDATE cart_items SET guest_count = #{guestCount}, check_in_date = #{checkInDate}, check_out_date = #{checkOutDate}, price = #{price}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE cart_item_id = #{cartItemId} AND deleted_at IS NULL -- soft delete되지 않은 아이템만 업데이트
